newsitem.title: UK: F&C's new Russian equity fund attracts $12 million.
newsitem.headline: F&C's new Russian equity fund attracts $12 million.

text.p: Foreign and Colonial Emerging Markets said on Tuesday a new fund set up for investing purely in Russian equities has attracted investment worth almost $12 million.

"Foreign and Colonial Emerging Markets Limited has launched an open-ended dollar denominated fund investing exclusively in traded Russian equities," the fund managers said in a statement released in London.
"The fund size is currently just under $12 million.

The vehicle, called the Russian Investment Company SICAV (Rusco), aims to invest solely in Russian stocks traded on local Russian stock exchanges and to be fully invested at all times, the statement said.
Launched on June 27, 1996, the fund's minimum investment requirement is $25,000. It is open to professional investors only and is currently 90 percent invested.
The fund will be managed by Foreign and Colonial's Isabel Knight. Annual management fee is 1.5 percent plus a performance fee.
